headline: BAL @ WSN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is BAL 4.41 at WSN 4.91, with a projected total of 9.33. Movement read: Both offenses moved down (BAL -0.25, WSN -0.18), so the movement points more toward run suppression than a clearer side. The projected total fell -0.43, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +5.9%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Shane Baz has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 3.8 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Pete Alonso, Daylen Lile, James Wood, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Tyler O'Neill, Nasim Nuñez because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
